package student

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func (useCase StudentUseCase) SetPracticeTaskPublicationVisibility(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID, studentPracticeTaskID, visibilityValue string,
) (*domain.PracticeTaskPublicationView, error) {
	visibility, err := parsePublicationVisibility(visibilityValue)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if useCase.Publications == nil || useCase.PublicationFiles == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("practice task publication is not configured")
	}
	project, err := useCase.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	existing, err := useCase.Publications.GetPublicationByProjectID(ctx, project.ID)
	if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return nil, err
	}
	if existing == nil && visibility == domain.PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityPrivate {
		return nil, nil
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if existing != nil {
		publishedAt := existing.PublishedAt
		if visibility != domain.PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityPrivate && publishedAt == nil {
			publishedAt = &now
		}
		if existing.Status == domain.PracticeTaskPublicationStatusPending {
			if err := useCase.PublicationFiles.Activate(ctx, existing.SnapshotStorageFileID); err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("activate publication snapshot: %w", err)
			}
			if err := useCase.Publications.MarkPublicationReady(ctx, existing.ID, visibility, publishedAt, now); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		} else if err := useCase.Publications.UpdatePublicationVisibility(ctx, existing.ID, visibility, publishedAt, now); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return useCase.GetPracticeTaskPublicationForOwner(ctx, studentID, project.ID)
	}
	if project.Status != domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusCompleted {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: only a mentor-approved completed practice task can be published", domain.ErrInvalidStatus)
	}

	review, artifact, err := useCase.publicationSource(ctx, project)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sourceArchive, err := useCase.PublicationFiles.DownloadSourceArchive(ctx, artifact.StorageFileID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("download approved submission artifact: %w", err)
	}
	prepared, err := preparePublicationSnapshot(sourceArchive)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	taskSnapshot, err := useCase.buildPublicationTaskSnapshot(ctx, project)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	resultSnapshot := domain.PracticeTaskPublicationResultSnapshot{
		Passed:      true,
		MentorScore: review.MentorScore,
		CompletedAt: project.CompletedAt,
		ReviewedAt:  review.ReviewedAt,
	}
	manifestJSON, err := json.Marshal(prepared.Manifest)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	securityReportJSON, err := json.Marshal(prepared.SecurityReport)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	taskSnapshotJSON, err := json.Marshal(taskSnapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	resultSnapshotJSON, err := json.Marshal(resultSnapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	shareSlug, err := newPublicationShareSlug()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fileID, err := useCase.PublicationFiles.UploadTemporaryArchive(
		ctx,
		project.StudentID,
		"practice-task-"+shareSlug+".snapshot",
		prepared.Archive,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("upload publication snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	publication := domain.StudentPracticeTaskPublication{
		ID:                    uuid.NewString(),
		StudentPracticeTaskID: project.ID,
		StudentID:             project.StudentID,
		ShareSlug:             shareSlug,
		Visibility:            domain.PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityPrivate,
		Status:                domain.PracticeTaskPublicationStatusPending,
		SnapshotStorageFileID: fileID,
		SnapshotSHA256:        prepared.SHA256,
		SnapshotManifestJSON:  manifestJSON,
		SecurityReportJSON:    securityReportJSON,
		TaskSnapshotJSON:      taskSnapshotJSON,
		ResultSnapshotJSON:    resultSnapshotJSON,
		CreatedAt:             now,
		UpdatedAt:             now,
	}
	if err := useCase.Publications.CreatePendingPublication(ctx, publication); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := useCase.PublicationFiles.Activate(ctx, fileID); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("activate publication snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	var publishedAt *time.Time
	if visibility != domain.PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityPrivate {
		publishedAt = &now
	}
	if err := useCase.Publications.MarkPublicationReady(ctx, publication.ID, visibility, publishedAt, now); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return useCase.GetPracticeTaskPublicationForOwner(ctx, studentID, project.ID)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) GetPracticeTaskPublicationForOwner(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID, studentPracticeTaskID string,
) (*domain.PracticeTaskPublicationView, error) {
	if useCase.Publications == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	project, err := useCase.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	publication, err := useCase.Publications.GetPublicationByProjectID(ctx, project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return publicationView(publication, true, nil)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) GetPublicPracticeTaskPublication(
	ctx context.Context,
	shareSlug string,
) (*domain.PracticeTaskPublicationView, error) {
	if useCase.Publications == nil || useCase.PublicationFiles == nil || !validPublicationShareSlug(shareSlug) {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	publication, err := useCase.Publications.GetPublicationBySlug(ctx, shareSlug)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	archive, err := useCase.PublicationFiles.DownloadPublicationSnapshot(ctx, publication.SnapshotStorageFileID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("download publication snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(archive)
	if hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]) != publication.SnapshotSHA256 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: publication snapshot checksum mismatch", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	prepared, err := preparePublicationSnapshot(archive)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return publicationView(publication, false, prepared.Files)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) ListPublicPracticeTaskPublications(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
) ([]domain.PracticeTaskPublicationSummary, error) {
	if useCase.Publications == nil {
		return []domain.PracticeTaskPublicationSummary{}, nil
	}
	items, err := useCase.Publications.ListPublicationsByStudentID(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result := make([]domain.PracticeTaskPublicationSummary, 0, len(items))
	for index := range items {
		view, err := publicationView(&items[index], false, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, domain.PracticeTaskPublicationSummary{
			ShareSlug: view.ShareSlug, PublishedAt: view.PublishedAt, Task: view.Task, Result: view.Result,
		})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) publicationSource(
	ctx context.Context,
	project *domain.StudentPracticeTask,
) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, *domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact, error) {
	reviews, err := useCase.Students.ListFinalReviews(ctx, project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	var approved *domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview
	for index := range reviews {
		if reviews[index].Status == domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPassed &&
			reviews[index].MentorStatus == domain.PracticeTaskMentorReviewStatusPassed &&
			reviews[index].ArtifactID != nil {
			item := reviews[index]
			approved = &item
			break
		}
	}
	if approved == nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: a passed mentor review with an immutable artifact is required", domain.ErrInvalidStatus)
	}
	artifacts, err := useCase.Students.ListArtifacts(ctx, project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	for index := range artifacts {
		if artifacts[index].ID == *approved.ArtifactID && strings.TrimSpace(artifacts[index].StorageFileID) != "" {
			artifact := artifacts[index]
			return approved, &artifact, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: approved publication artifact was not found", domain.ErrValidation)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) buildPublicationTaskSnapshot(
	ctx context.Context,
	project *domain.StudentPracticeTask,
) (domain.PracticeTaskPublicationTaskSnapshot, error) {
	runtimeContext, err := useCase.getStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeContext(ctx, project)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeTaskPublicationTaskSnapshot{}, err
	}
	variant, err := selectPracticeTaskSolutionVariant(runtimeContext.SolutionVariants, project.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeTaskPublicationTaskSnapshot{}, err
	}
	milestones, err := milestonesForSolutionVariant(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, variant)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeTaskPublicationTaskSnapshot{}, err
	}
	sort.SliceStable(milestones, func(left, right int) bool {
		return milestones[left].SortOrder < milestones[right].SortOrder
	})
	milestoneSnapshots := make([]domain.PracticeTaskPublicationMilestoneSnapshot, 0, len(milestones))
	for _, milestone := range milestones {
		milestoneSnapshots = append(milestoneSnapshots, domain.PracticeTaskPublicationMilestoneSnapshot{
			Title: milestone.Title, Description: milestone.Description,
			StackCodes: append([]string(nil), milestone.StackCodes...), SortOrder: milestone.SortOrder,
		})
	}
	return domain.PracticeTaskPublicationTaskSnapshot{
		PracticeTaskID: runtimeContext.PracticeTask.ID,
		RevisionNumber: runtimeContext.RevisionNumber,
		Title:          runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Title,
		Theme:          runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Theme,
		VariantCode:    variant.Code,
		VariantTitle:   variant.Title,
		Topology:       variant.Topology,
		StackCodes:     append([]string(nil), variant.StackCodes...),
		Milestones:     milestoneSnapshots,
	}, nil
}

func publicationView(
	publication *domain.StudentPracticeTaskPublication,
	includeSecurityReport bool,
	files []domain.WorkspaceFile,
) (*domain.PracticeTaskPublicationView, error) {
	if publication == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	var manifest domain.PracticeTaskPublicationManifest
	if err := json.Unmarshal(publication.SnapshotManifestJSON, &manifest); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode publication manifest: %w", err)
	}
	var task domain.PracticeTaskPublicationTaskSnapshot
	if err := json.Unmarshal(publication.TaskSnapshotJSON, &task); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode publication task snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	var result domain.PracticeTaskPublicationResultSnapshot
	if err := json.Unmarshal(publication.ResultSnapshotJSON, &result); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode publication result snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	view := &domain.PracticeTaskPublicationView{
		ShareSlug:   publication.ShareSlug,
		Visibility:  publicationVisibilityLabel(publication.Visibility),
		PublishedAt: publication.PublishedAt, CreatedAt: publication.CreatedAt,
		Task: task, Result: result, Manifest: manifest, Files: files,
	}
	if includeSecurityReport {
		view.ID = publication.ID
		var report domain.PracticeTaskPublicationSecurityReport
		if err := json.Unmarshal(publication.SecurityReportJSON, &report); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode publication security report: %w", err)
		}
		view.SecurityReport = &report
	}
	return view, nil
}

func parsePublicationVisibility(value string) (int16, error) {
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
	case "private":
		return domain.PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityPrivate, nil
	case "unlisted":
		return domain.PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityUnlisted, nil
	case "public":
		return domain.PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityPublic, nil
	default:
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: visibility must be private, unlisted, or public", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
}

func publicationVisibilityLabel(value int16) string {
	switch value {
	case domain.PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityUnlisted:
		return "unlisted"
	case domain.PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityPublic:
		return "public"
	default:
		return "private"
	}
}

func newPublicationShareSlug() (string, error) {
	buffer := make([]byte, 24)
	if _, err := rand.Read(buffer); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("generate publication share slug: %w", err)
	}
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(buffer), nil
}

func validPublicationShareSlug(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != 32 {
		return false
	}
	_, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(value)
	return err == nil
}
